2.0.0.0.added:
Rebuilt on the Construct addon SDK v2. Same addon id, same actions, conditions, expressions and properties, so it drops into existing projects.
Typewriter easing now accepts any easing made in the project's easings editor, looked up by name. Use the Custom Easing property or the "Set Typewriter Easing (by name)" action.
Typewriter state now shows up in the debugger.
The alias name in "Set Function Animation alias" now autocompletes across actions.
2.0.0.0.changed:
ACTION NEEDED: the Typewriter Easing dropdown is now Construct's own easings, so the curves match the timeline and the tween behavior. Construct stores a dropdown value as a position in the list rather than a name, so if you ever changed Typewriter Easing away from Linear, open the property and pick it again. Easings written as text are not affected: the Custom Easing property and "Set Typewriter Easing (by name)" still accept every 1.x name, including the camelCase spellings.
Six 1.x easings were duplicates under a second name and now resolve to the Construct curve they always were: swingFrom is ease in back, swingTo is ease out back, swingFromTo is ease in out back, bounce is ease out bounce, easeFrom is ease in quart, easeFromTo is ease in out quart. elastic never left 1.0 in 1.x, so it did nothing at all, and now maps to ease out elastic. bouncePast and easeTo have no Construct equivalent and are kept.
Save states now store the text you passed in and rebuild the parsed animation when loading, instead of serialising live functions. Save states made with 1.x will not load into 2.0.0.0.
Script interface methods are now generated from the actions. setTwEasing(name) is now setTwEasingString(name), and skipTwToNextPause(toEnd) is now skipTw(mode) where mode 0 skips to the end and 1 skips to the next pause.
2.0.0.0.fixed:
Easing curves now reach their end value. They were evaluated over a duration of 1.01 instead of 1, so a curve stopped just short: ease in circ reached 0.874 rather than 1.
Set Text no longer crashes when a typewriter is still running. It kept the old typewriter timings while swapping in the new text, so the next tick ran off the end of them as soon as the new text was longer. Set Text now cancels the typewriter.
Animated icons work again. A solo tag written as [sfdx=icon ...][/sfdx] rendered nothing, because a solo tag is only drawn next to a character and that spelling has no characters. It now expands the same way the [icon=...] spelling always did.
Colour helpers accept the current CSS syntax. Browsers stopped accepting unitless values in the comma form of hsl(), so hsl(0,100,50) has to be written hsl(0,100%,50%) or hsl(0 100% 50%). colorToHex and lerpColor now read all three forms, so old content keeps working.
Linking a dictionary and then loading a save state left the link broken, because the instance was restored instead of its data map. [var=...] tags stopped resolving after a load.
TypedTextWidth and TypedTextHeight returned an invalid value when the behavior was on an object that is not Text or Sprite Font. They now return 0.
The LastLetter expression returned an invalid value before the first letter was typed. It now returns an empty string.
Removed four pieces of internal state that were saved but never read.
